issues.title: Upgrade Physics System to Box2D Integration
issues.description: Upgrade the current basic pygame physics to a comprehensive Box2D-based physics system for realistic vehicle and character physics.
acceptance_criteria: Integration with existing code is seamless

issues.title: Implement Advanced Vehicle Features (Damage, Passengers, Animations)
issues.description: Implement comprehensive vehicle features inspired by Carnage3D including damage system, passenger management, door animations, and emergency lights.
acceptance_criteria: Vehicles can take damage and show visual effects
All vehicle states (normal, damaged, burning) work

issues.title: Enhance Character AI with Fear Responses and Advanced Behaviors
issues.description: Implement advanced AI behaviors for pedestrians including fear responses, vehicle interactions, and complex animation states.
tasks: Implement character states (idle, walking, shooting, etc.)
acceptance_criteria: Health and damage systems work properly

issues.title: Implement 3D World System with Multiple Layers
issues.description: Add 3D world system with multiple layers and improved collision detection, building on the existing pixel art map system.
acceptance_criteria: Integration with TMX maps is seamless
issues.notes: 3D World System with multiple layers, collision detection, district management, navigation sectors, pathfinding, and TMX integration completed successfully. All core features tested and working.

issues.title: Implement Traffic Management with AI-Controlled Vehicles
issues.description: Create a comprehensive traffic management system with AI-controlled vehicles and dynamic spawning.
acceptance_criteria: Traffic vehicles spawn and despawn dynamically
AI vehicles follow realistic driving patterns
Performance remains stable with many vehicles
issues.notes: Traffic Management System with AI-controlled vehicles completed successfully. Features include dynamic spawning/despawning, multiple behavior types, district-based density, spawn points, traffic routes, and comprehensive statistics. All acceptance criteria met.
